inputs.text: The real question is not whether the state should rank families, but whether an inheritance system deepens inequality by giving wealth an easier path across generations. People without children should not be treated as less deserving, and families come in many forms. But “family responsibility” should not become a blanket defense of tax advantages for inherited wealth. Any review should ensure equal treatment while protecting the public resources and fairness that make society work for everyone—not just those fortunate enough to inherit.

subtopics: Equal treatment of people without children
